digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate / lint and typecheck automation
propositions: Approved maintainability and reliability quality gates cannot be enforced wholesale because existing diagnostics in the codebase block enforcement.
Four Mypy settings (no_implicit_optional, strict_equality, warn_redundant_casts, warn_unused_ignores) must be enabled after validating and resolving measured diagnostics.
Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rule families must be enabled after making three sites timezone-explicit and resolving conflicts.
C901 complexity gate must be introduced with a shrink-only baseline at threshold 15 to capture existing violations without blocking enforcement.
Ruff RUF hygiene violations must be cleared and captured in a ratchet test before enforcement, deferring RUF001/RUF002/RUF003.
All newly enforced gates must exit zero against current origin/main before landing, and any pre-existing ratchet-family diagnostics introduced by main drift must be resolved.
